events.verdict: Hield (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during Randle's (MIN) drive to the basket.
Payton II (GSW) brushes Alexander-Walker's (MIN) leg and the contact does not affect Alexander-Walker's SQBR.
Green (GSW) places a hand on Alexander-Walker's (MIN) body during the driving shot attempt and the contact is marginal. Payton II (GSW) legally contests the driving shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) rests a forearm against Kuminga's (GSW) side and Kuminga loses his footing on his own.
Kuminga (GSW) moves his pivot foot upon gathering the ball.
Payton II (GSW) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Edwards (MIN) as Edwards receives the pass.
McDaniels (MIN) establishes a screening position in Hield's (GSW) path and absorbs the contact as he moves backwards.
Curry (GSW) is established in a screening position in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path and he does not deliver contact.

Hield (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position during Edwards' (MIN) drive to the basket. As Edwards elevates, Hield maintains a hand on his body and the contact is marginal. Additionally, Green (GSW) legally contests the driving shot attempt.
Curry (GSW) establishes a screening position in Gobert's (MIN) path and does not deliver illegal contact as he sets the pick.
McDaniels (MIN) brings his hand forwards and the contact with Green (GSW) during his dunk is marginal.
Gobert (MIN) and Green (GSW) briefly engage and disengage in the post.
Kuminga (GSW) brushes Randle's (MIN) arm and does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Kuminga (GSW) cleanly blocks Randle's (MIN) shot attempt and the body contact is marginal.
